facts.text: John had a career-high in assists last Friday in a game against their rival.

evidence.quote: I had a career-high in assists last Friday in our big game against our rival.

facts.text: John described a game where he was down 10 in the 4th quarter and hit a buzzer-beater shot to win.

evidence.quote: My favorite was when we were down 10 in the 4th and I hit the buzzer-beater shot to win.

facts.text: John mentioned that playing against rivals adds an extra level of intensity to games.

evidence.quote: playing against our rivals added an extra level of intensity.

facts.text: John shared that he practiced basketball outside for hours as a way to deal with doubts and stress.

evidence.quote: I'd practice basketball outside for hours, dreaming of playing in big games. It was my way of dealing with doubts and stress.
